quantity: Total demand relative to available renewable water supply
temporal_statistic: Aqueduct 4.0 annual baseline; monthly demand-weighted aggregation, 1979–2019 inputs
spatial_support: HydroBASINS 6; use basin support despite finer polygon intersections

binding.nodata: unknown; status and sentinel validation required

rationale: Keep source bands at 10/20/40/80 percent separate from proposed method classes. No source-defined none category. Do not relabel low stress as none or treat arid status as a raw negative number.
alternatives: Hold under v1; preserve five provider classes for description (recommended first release).
Propose new three-class threshold mode with fixed cuts 0.2 and 0.4, low/medium/high only, preserving source detail; endpoint and arid treatment need review.
Four-class [0, 0.2, 0.4] would reserve none for validated zero demand ratio, not low stress; this is a design interpretation, not source-established none.
blockers: Decide four-class mapping or reviewed three-class threshold extension
Verify raw value domain, NoData and arid status in actual asset
Register/review source packets; approve context and binding
